Alex: quick RFC follow-up — we sketched invariants needed across hosted/dedicated/private. summary: keep policy decision central, avoid leaking policy blobs to runtimes.
Nadia: +1. suggest naming it the "grant broker" to make clear it's a minimal gate: verify attestation -> issue ephemeral grant.
Rasheed: question: what attestor types do we support? hw_attest, agent_key, proxy_mtls, kms_offline? need a small enum and verification levels OK/WEAK/FAIL.
Ivy: agree. also add enforcement tiers: AUDIT, WARN, ENFORCE, DEGRADE. map defaults: hosted->ENFORCE, dedicated->WARN/ENFORCE per contract, private->configurable by operator.
Alex: release flow (hosted/dedicated): runtime -> broker challenge -> runtime attests -> broker validates -> broker returns short-lived JWS grant. private: support kms_offline where operator triggers local unlock.
Nadia: token shape: JWS claims {sub, scope, exp, rid, evidence_hash}. signed by broker jwk. runtime uses in Authorization header. keep TTL small and require keepalive for streaming.
Rasheed: caching: per (tenant, model, route). default grant_cache_ttl=300s. hot-lease for streaming with heartbeat 15s. invalidate on model/version rollout.
Ivy: telemetry: emit release_event with policy_id, adapter, evidence_hash, release_cid. never log grants or raw evidence. evidence minimization: store only hashes and a small trust_level enum.
Alex: offline unlock UX: controlplane stores ciphertext; operator runs `redwood escrow unlock --id <policy> --approver <key>` locally which writes grant to local broker and records audit entry. no outbound traffic required.
Nadia: emergency override: 2-person signed override that issues a signed override grant, logged and escalated. include CLI friendly flow and alerting rules.
Rasheed: failure semantics: if required signal missing -> if policy flagged must_guard -> DENY else -> DEGRADE. runtime should call GET /runtime/available_signals at startup.
Ivy: performance note: attestation roundtrip adds 20-120ms. recommend pre-warm grants for hot routes and provide client-side cache. include guidance for p99 sensitive paths.
Alex: evidence reveal policy: default = forbidden; provide reveal flow for authorized reviewers with signed reveal request and short TTL; certain policies may forbid reveal entirely.
Nadia: tests & harness: include attestor simulators (hw_ok, agent_ok, agent_weak, kms_offline), churn test for 1k tenants, and time-skew negative tests. add migration mode warn->deny for 14d grace.
Rasheed: docs: publish small compatibility table showing signals by mode and example `policy.check` API sample. also add SDK change: PolicyClient.check(...) sync + async for streaming.
Ivy: ops playbook: checklist for debug: check broker jwks, clock skew, attestor cert chain, evidence_hash mapping. include curl examples and common alerts for repeated failures.
